## 1. Evidence or it didn't happen
Never report an item done without pasting the specific evidence.

## 2. Distinguish the three states honestly
Every reported item must be labeled DONE, OPEN, or ASSUMED.

## Code Style
- Use 2-space indentation
- No semicolons

## Deployment Notes
Deploys go through the staging environment first. Production pushes require
a second approval from the on-call engineer.
